name: Thomas Ramon Martin
office: City of Maywood, Member of the City Council

items.text: Thomas Ramon Martin was elected to the Maywood City Council in 1994. He won re-election in 1997. State election records from 2002 list his occupation as a council member and engineer.

sentences.text: Thomas Ramon Martin was elected to the Maywood City Council in 1994.
State election records from 2002 list his occupation as a council member and engineer.

items.text: He supports job creation for youth and new educational programs, as well as more city security. He advocates for a cleaner city, more trees, a cleaner environment and community resources. He has said the city council has not acted against Lineage.
